editorial.blurb: Since 1997, Rubi's has grown from a taco stand into a Chicago icon, beloved for hand-patted tortillas made fresh to order and an impressive rotating lineup of house-made salsas.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive right before the lunch rush to avoid long lines, and save room for multiple tacos—the consensus is one if you're polite, two if you're sensible, three or four if you're honest with yourself.
